description: array_agg of a multi-field ROW() constructor must not silently collapse to the first field's type -- it has no single neutral type today, so it must surface as an unresolved element type instead of a confidently wrong scalar one

columns.name: rows
columns.note: ROW(...) parses as a function call, not a tuple; before the fix this inferred array<__unknown_func__:row>, an opaque type name codegen cannot resolve, instead of a clean array<unknown>

name: array_agg_row_constructor_is_unknown
schema_sql: CREATE TABLE orders (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, total NUMERIC NOT NULL);
